note: Multiplicative 95% interval ratios to the median rate, as natural logs. Apply as lo95 = rate * exp(lo_ratio), hi95 = rate * exp(hi_ratio). by_position is the published per-site interval and is exact; by_type_context is a mean over sites and is an approximation that the engine flags. Substitutions only -- indel interval widths are too variable to summarise and indels are not part of custom output.
